ownership.argument: The wake path, exactly: ring append at runtime+0x50..0x64, then uv_async_send on runtime+0x3C. That async is the Feature runtime thread's own handle, not the module async.

provenance.source: Appends the task into the runtime's message ring (runtime+80 buffer base, +84/+88 bounds, +92/+96 head/tail indices, +100 next sequence) as a 24-byte element (0xAA elements per block, 5 words copied), then wakes the runtime through uv_async_send 0xC2E15A4 on the async object stored at runtime+60 (word index 15).
